mapper.sql: -- 根据用户ID查询所有有效权限（考虑部门继承、岗位、用户直连） WITH user_subjects AS ( -- 1. 用户主体本身 SELECT 'USER' AS sub_type, #{userId} AS sub_id UNION ALL -- 2. 用户所属部门及其所有上级部门 (实现部门继承) SELECT 'DEPT' AS sub_type, dc.ancestor_id AS sub_id FROM user_dept ud JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} AND ud.status = 0 UNION ALL -- 3. 用户所属岗位 SELECT 'POST' AS sub_type, up.post_id AS sub_id FROM user_post up WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.status = 0 -- 4. 未来扩展：在此处 UNION ALL 增加 PROJECT 或其他主体即可 -- UNION ALL SELECT 'PROJECT', project_id FROM user_project ... )

WITH base_subjects AS ( SELECT 'USER' AS sub_type, #{userId} AS sub_id UNION ALL SELECT 'DEPT' AS sub_type, dc.ancestor_id AS sub_id FROM user_dept ud JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} AND ud.status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'POST' AS sub_type, up.post_id AS sub_id FROM user_post up WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.status = 0 -- 4. 未来扩展：在此处 UNION ALL 增加 PROJECT 或其他主体即可 -- UNION ALL SELECT 'PROJECT', project_id FROM user_project ... ), all_subjects AS ( SELECT sub_type, sub_id FROM base_subjects UNION SELECT DISTINCT 'ROLE' AS sub_type, r.id AS sub_id FROM grant_table gt JOIN sys_role r ON gt.role_code = r.role_code JOIN base_subjects bs ON gt.subject_type = bs.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = bs.sub_id WHERE r.status = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 )

SELECT DISTINCT gt.subject_id AS uid FROM grant_table gt WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'USER' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ud.user_id AS uid FROM grant_table gt JOIN dept_closure dc ON dc.ancestor_id = gt.subject_id JOIN user_dept ud ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'DEPT' AND ud.status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT up.user_id AS uid FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_post up ON up.post_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'POST' AND (up.status IS NULL OR up.status = 0)
